decisions.definition: Shortest continuous cue duration giving D >= 0.5 after cue withdrawal and the declared recovery period.
decisions.field_stability: Record the full native-field tail and its finite-tail gate separately from replacement fate.
remaining_parameters: Recover the exact pilot dominance/challenger-zone definition from the named harness.
Declare recovery periods and finite observation horizons for every model.
Report sampled success/failure brackets and test monotonicity locally rather than assuming global monotonicity.

decisions.user_answer_verbatim: You don't have access to it. Design the campaign around project local docs/solvers - that was a rough pilot assay and shoudn't need to be followed exactly. LMK if that is a blocker.
decisions.consequence: Use retained project-local native solvers and explicitly declared new assay definitions. External pilot and 102 retained-assay results are unavailable, so their numerical values remain unverified and required supporting assays must be regenerated. This is not a blocker.

decisions.primary_dominance: D=(E_right-E_left)/(E_right+E_left), using disjoint half-domain positive activity excess above the instantaneous spatial minimum. D>=0.5 means at least 75% of this excess is in the challenger half. Undefined or numerically negligible excess is flagged.
decisions.zone_sensitivities: Additionally retain challenger amount over fixed widest support and each cue's own support, including overlap with the fixed basal incumbent core. These changing zones do not define primary replacement fate.
decisions.spatial_cue: Project-native boundary raised cosine, rescaled at each evaluation so its actual native spatial quadrature equals the requested commanded area. deBelly uses nominal solver coordinates; Spring uses instantaneous physical coordinates.
decisions.reference_area: Native model-specific peak times 3.8; Spring native peak times 0.1. This is commanded input area per ON time, without an optical calibration or equal cumulative molecular dose claim.
decisions.spring_resting_length_mapping: L_spring=L_nominal/15, based on the existing reference-length convention (1 versus 15), with fresh qualifying basals where exact retained states are absent. This is a comparison convention, not a measured unit conversion.
decisions.train_quantization: For deBelly retain native step 0.5. Round each requested total ON upward to a common multiple of 4, so pulse counts 2/4/8 have identical actual total ON and every pulse is on-lattice. Round inter-pulse gaps to the nearest half-unit, recording requested and actual factors.

decisions.evidence: SLURM 21229850 tasks 6 and 7 completed native Holmes preparation integrations but failed an overly strict minimum-preparation-pulse bracket check. Every tested positive seed converged to the same qualified polarized endpoint; the zero-seed state was homogeneous.
decisions.decision: Qualify a stable polarized endpoint using native full-field convergence and holdout checks, then require an independent full-field no-cue replay. Preserve unresolved minimum preparation-pulse duration explicitly. A globally minimum seed pulse is not required to prepare an exact stable basal.
decisions.scope: This changes preparation acceptance bookkeeping only. It does not alter the post-withdrawal commitment calibration, response-fate thresholds, native kinetics, or field-stability criteria.
decisions.retention: Original frozen payload, terminal errors and trial histories remain intact. Requalified checkpoint copies and audit receipts are separate outputs.

decisions.conditions: Wave-pinning and deBelly at L19/L29/L39; four pulses with total ON 1.5 times calibrated commitment; gap multiples 1/4/16; two weak mean levels; twelve independent seeds per condition.
decisions.weak_input_means: 0.005 and 0.02 times the retained native response peak. These fractions define the assay and are not a cross-model physical calibration.
decisions.forcing: Bounded positive activation input q=mean*(1+tanh(Z)), where Z is the stationary unit-variance nonperiodic Gaussian field from spatial-exponential and temporal-OU knots with variance-normalized interpolation. Apply during inter-pulse gaps only; final recovery noise-free. At mean fractions0.005/0.02, the hard upper input bounds are0.01/0.04 times the retained native cue peak. No clipping or normalization of a realization.
decisions.controls: 36 matched-mean deterministic conditions and 18 zero-input conditions in addition to 432 noise realizations. Compare variance effects with the matched mean, not only with zero input.
decisions.retention_measure: Report activity share and D at every pulse/gap endpoint and their changes. Operational retention requires eligible challenger-biased activity at pulse end (D>=0), eligible D>=0 at gap end, and gap-end challenger share at least 80% of pulse-end share. Show establishment/eligibility coverage separately from retention probability.
decisions.sensitivity: Retain continuous share-loss measurements and compare 70%, 80% and 90% share-retention thresholds. Report finite ensemble uncertainty and native no-noise recovery field-tail flags separately.
decisions.latent_correlation: Gaussian spatial correlation length1.9 in native nominal coordinates, temporal correlation time10 for Wave-pinning and5 for deBelly, knot intervals2.5 and0.5 respectively. Nonlinear transformed-input correlations are measured separately and are not assumed equal to the latent OU/exponential correlations.
decisions.preserved_initial_pilot: The original lognormal-input pilot is retained unchanged. Its means were small but sampled maxima reached2.85 times the reference cue peak, so it cannot establish uniformly weak-input robustness. The original full lognormal payload remains unsubmitted, with an explicit hold receipt.
decisions.new_bounded_pilot: Six conditions at L39 and gap16: noise, matched mean and zero for Wave-pinning and deBelly; require identity, native invariants and hard-bound audits before the full486-condition bounded ensemble.

decisions.observation: Holmes L27 now has a sampled commitment bracket with upper18125. L31,35,39 have no sampled post-withdrawal75%-half-share commitment through100000 ON.
decisions.native_profile_check: At the extended horizon L31,35,39 retain distinct active Rac regions near both ends after withdrawal; failed dominance is not caused by a single challenger region spilling across the midpoint.
decisions.interpretation: These are finite declared assay limits, not proof that commitment is impossible at every duration. Never substitute the horizon for an unavailable calibration or fabricate dependent train schedules.

decisions.primary: First cue-site positive excess peak reaching10% of the fixed within-model L19 basal excess peak. Use the same native reporter threshold across lengths and strengths.
decisions.rationale: Fixed within-model reporter threshold measures initiation independently of the growing incumbent peak;10% is a central reporting fraction, with all1/5/10/20% results retained. The1% threshold is already exceeded in some initial deBelly relative-width cue zones.
decisions.sensitivity: All450 width histories and54 same-peak relative-width histories independently reconstructed at1/5/10/20%. Original half-of-each-basal-peak threshold retained separately as height-maturation diagnostic.
decisions.baseline_presence: If the threshold is already exceeded at time0, record baseline-active status; do not invent a postcue activation event.
decisions.time_resolution: Report sampled brackets; deBelly first native step is(0,0.5], so substep interpolation is descriptive only.

decisions.rule: Show L39 when calibrated; otherwise the largest calibrated length. Holmes usesL27 with L39-calibration-unavailable explicitly printed in E and F.
decisions.limits: All L39 unavailable cells remain in maps and supplement. This is not a cross-model equal-length comparison or an outcome-selected successful example.
